name: Semi-permeable capsule (SPC) workflow: Gelation, emulsion breaking, curing and capsule wash chip
source: Leonaviciene & Mazutis, Nucleic Acids Research 2023; Baronas et al., Science 2026; Semi-permeable capsule (SPC) workflow: generic protocol; autochip/examples/spc_capsule_protocol.md
description: Generated by autochip from protocol IR 'spc_capsule_workflow' for chip chip2_gelation_emulsion_break_cure_wash (Gels the shells in a cold delay line, then breaks the emulsion, photocures and washes the capsules in a trap.). Flows, volumes and times the source did not give are placeholders.

steps.note: IR step 11 (gelation_delay): load the droplets from the hand-off from chip1_rinse_dissociation_quench_wash_encapsulation: syringe on inlet_1 at 5 uL/min, VENT capsule_trap_waste_out. Every other port capped.
IR step 11 (gelation_delay): all ports capped, hold 4 C for 30 min. Collect the emulsion and keep it on ice so the shell gels.
IR step 12 (capsule_trap): move the droplets from gelation_delay to capsule_trap: FEED inlet_1 (carrier buffer), VENT capsule_trap_waste_out. Every other port capped.

IR step 12 (capsule_trap): exchange to emulsion_breaking_agent: FEED emulsion_breaking_agent_in (emulsion_breaking_agent) at 5 uL/min, VENT capsule_trap_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash (default flow). Break the emulsion with an emulsion-breaking agent and remove the oil phase.

IR step 13 (capsule_trap): exchange to photoinitiator: FEED photoinitiator_in (photoinitiator) at 20 uL/min, VENT capsule_trap_waste_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (75 uL) per wash (default flow). Photocure the capsule shells with 405 nm light in the presence of photoinitiator.
IR step 13 (capsule_trap): cure under 405 nm light for 30 s, all ports capped. Photocure the capsule shells with 405 nm light in the presence of photoinitiator.

IR step 14 (capsule_trap): exchange to wash_buffer: FEED wash_buffer_in (wash_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT capsule_trap_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash x 3 washes (default flow). Wash the capsules in buffer to remove oil and free reagents.

IR step 14 (capsule_trap): collect the capsules: FEED wash_buffer_in (buffer push), VENT outlet_1 into a tube labelled 'chip2_gelation_emulsion_break_cure_wash: capsules after step 14, for chip3_filter_lysis_rt_wash inlet_1'. Every other port capped.
